provenance.author: AUD-07 product slice (Claude)
provenance.notes: One case per compared field (#32 r3 deferred item): only `final.lots` separates the right answer from the wrong one. Long entry at the open of 280, stop 30 ATR away and no time exit on a flat tape: nothing closes, so the trade list is empty either way and a model that lost (or never opened) the lot differs in final.lots only. final is reported by the engine adapter (the backtester exposes no open-position list).
